package.author: Giuseppe Penone
package.description: A hierarchical note taking application, featuring rich text and syntax highlighting, storing data in a single xml or sqlite file.

en-US.author: Giuseppe Penone
en-US.description: A hierarchical note taking application, featuring rich text and syntax highlighting, storing data in a single xml or sqlite file.
en-US.longDescription: A hierarchical note taking application, featuring rich text and syntax highlighting, storing data in either a single file (xml or sqlite) or multiple files and directories.
en-US.name: CherryTree
en-US.releaseNotes:
- fixed command injection with custom link actions (@r3vpwnx, @Afnaan-Ahmed #2945 CVE-2026-118692)
- fixed arbitrary local file read via crafted embedded-file name (@Afnaan-Ahmed, #2944 CVE-2026-118693)
- reject symlinked multifile node directories + prevent cleanup from following symlinks (@acts-1631, #2922, #2920)
- reject empty tables during XML parsing so malformed XML cannot reach table construction or clipboard indexing (@acts-1631, #2923)
- on node name header, show node icon and aux icons on the left rather than on the right, just after last visited nodes buttons
- improved image download on HTML paste from browser (#2925)
- fixed crash when destroying anchored widgets (#2947)
- support for new language Tamil (@TamilNeram)
- build with libxml++5 on windows/msys2, ubuntu 26.04+, flatpak (#2918, @bgermann)

zh-CN.author: Giuseppe Penone
zh-CN.description: 一个层级式笔记记录程序，具有富文本和代码高亮的功能
zh-CN.longDescription: 一个层级式笔记记录程序，具有富文本和代码高亮的功能，数据存储在单个文件（xml或sqlite）或多个文件和目录中。
zh-CN.name: CherryTree
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
- fixed links to TOCs (anchors) no longer scrolling to the target (#2768, #2766, #2389)
- default option for searching multiple words is back to 'exact match' as way faster; the last used option is now preserved across sessions (#2767)
